source_semantics.summary: Current AIMWWeb DatabaseSetupService.RenderPage owns first-run setup-page composition, setup defaults, error presentation, and the database/administrator setup form.
source_semantics.security_property: Dynamic error text is HTML encoded before it is emitted into the setup page.
source_semantics.first_run_boundary: The page is pre-authentication installation UI and does not operate on an already-selected tenant resource.

laravel_adaptation.database_credentials: deployment-owned; no database password or connection string is accepted as setup page-model input
laravel_adaptation.error_encoding: Blade escaped interpolation; operation-specific acceptance proves raw script markup is not emitted
laravel_adaptation.failure_message: bounded generic operator-safe message; caught exception details are reported server-side and are not rendered
laravel_adaptation.completion_semantics: completed installations continue to redirect away from /setup rather than render first-run UI
laravel_adaptation.standalone_rendering: the rendering service supplies an explicit ViewErrorBag so the page remains valid both through web middleware and when the service contract is exercised directly

security.authorization: pre-authentication first-run setup boundary; no authenticated tenant resource is selected by RenderPage
security.tenant_isolation: foreign tenant identifiers are not accepted as a setup-page selector or reflected into rendered output; a tenant-addressable /tenants/{foreign}/setup surface fails closed with 404
security.secret_handling: database/provider credentials remain deployment-owned and are never read into the rendered page model
security.error_output: Blade escaped interpolation prevents raw HTML/script injection and controller failures render bounded operator-safe text

acceptance.provenance: acceptance pins the canonical operation ID and DatabaseSetupService.RenderPage marker in the production adapter
acceptance.tenant_isolation: focused acceptance proves a foreign tenant token cannot select or appear in the pre-auth setup renderer and that a tenant-addressable setup path is not found

recovery.reason: PR #294 implementation is already an ancestor of the authoritative composition line, but the operation remained PENDING because its historical evidence predates the focused-service generator contract.
